game: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Winter Games
project: Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Winter Games native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Boots to the title, the save select and the name-entry keyboard. Intro and title run at 60 fps; known issue: the save-select and keyboard screens draw without the game's frame pacing (hundreds of pictures a second), so animations there can run fast. Tested on Windows 11 (RTX 3070 Ti) and on a Linux mini PC (Ryzen 3 4350GE, Vega 6) with scripted inputs; nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
